$comment: Every region the picker offers, in ONE file (same rule as limits.json). bbox is [w, s, e, n]. A sea with "live": false gets a null count in /v1/regions — null IS the coming-soon signal on the wire. Launch is the North Sea + English Channel, and the two launch straits are Dover + Kattegat (docs/01-mvp-spec.html §00 + F35: 'Dover Strait + Kattegat at launch'); the frame's Black Sea / Bosphorus cast is illustrative only.
